market_definition: Global Geospatial Analytics / GIS Market. Product / technology: Software: desktop GIS, web/mobile GIS, enterprise GIS; data: satellite, drone, LiDAR, IoT, demographic and cadastral data; technology: AI/ML, cloud, edge, GNSS. Business models: Software licensing/SaaS, data acquisition, geodatabase development, consulting and implementation, managed GIS services, custom application development. Applications: Urban planning, land administration, utilities, transportation, agriculture, environment, disaster management, defense, smart cities. End users: Government, utilities, telecom, construction, transportation, agriculture, mining, environmental agencies, enterprises. Geography: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, Middle East & Africa; India-specific municipal and state-level opportunity analysis.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (software / cloud market): a company whose business is RESELLING, distributing, white-labelling or aggregating another vendor's platform to its own customers - authorized reseller, master agent / master distributor, value-added reseller, white-label or wholesale aggregator, or a telecom aggregator reselling messaging/voice capacity. In this market the CHANNEL PARTNERS ARE THE DISTRIBUTORS, because there is no physical stock to warehouse. EXCLUDED: the platform vendors themselves and their own sales subsidiaries, system integrators and consultancies building bespoke solutions, and referral-only affiliates. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
